summary: Bonta voted Aye on AB 715, the antisemitism-coordinator and classroom-material oversight bill whose floor debate concerned speech about Palestine, after publicly registering skepticism and pressing co-authors to revise the text. CAIR Action preferred her and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally. Her documented reservations about the bill's rushed handling coexist with her final yes vote, and her platform contains no Palestine-specific policy statement.
